text:
marie: Heads-up — small-window hotfix for a tokenizer mem-leak that's affecting Dedicated EU pools. Need expedited approval for a midnight patch (30m change window).

marie: TL;DR: patch v2.3.1-hotfix, rolling canary -> staged ramp, rollback criteria defined below.

deploy-bot: Deploy request received: `v2.3.1-hotfix-20260321` by @marie. Staged rollout config: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Approvals required: eng-lead + oncall + product.

jordan: I can +1 from infra side if SLOs look stable during canary. Can we shorten canary checks to 6m checks (instead of 10)?

sam: @jordan prefer keep 10m for KV cache warm-up. 6m risks flapping. Suggest 10m for first two stages, then 5m for final ramp.

lee-sre: Oncall OK with expedited path if we have: (1) quick rollback playbook, (2) metrics dashboard pre-configured, (3) alert thresholds lowered. Can confirm after seeing runbook.

marie: Runbook snippet pasted below — minimal steps.

```
rollback: 
  - stop new canary traffic via routing flag
  - scale down canary instances to 0
  - revert model binary to v2.3.0
  - flush KV cache if mem spike persists
  - notify customers via status page if >5% of requests impacted
```

emily: Verified QA has smoke-tested the build (sanity tokenization on long docs). No regressions found in staging. +1 from eng-lead pending oncall signoff.

nate: Product approves expedited window; impacts customer-facing generation for some edge cases but acceptable for midnight window. I can be on-call to sign off final go/no-go.

ops-bot: Note: compliance brief required for EU private deployments? - minimal, we have audit logs enabled.

jordan: Suggest we pin the model-serving runtime to a known-good kernel during canary to avoid cross-version perf variance. Can we do `runtime: 1.14.2-pin` for the rollout?

marie: Yes — pin runtime to 1.14.2 for canary and first ramp. Good call. Adding to deploy config.

lee-sre: Approving with conditions: lowered thresholds and auto-rollback if error-rate > 1.5% OR latency P95 increases > 200ms for 2 consecutive checks.

deploy-bot: Approval recorded: emily, lee-sre, nate. Deploy window locked to 00:30-01:00 UTC. Command queued: `./deploy --version v2.3.1-hotfix --staged "5,25,100" --check-interval 600s --runtime 1.14.2-pin`

sam: :thumbsup: I will watch logs and have a hot rollback ready.

marie: Final ask — anyone object to fast-track? If no objections in 5m we proceed to schedule the deploy.

jordan: No objections from infra.

emily: no objections from eng-lead.

lee-sre: no objection, oncall standing by.

nate: no objection. Go ahead.

marie: Great — proceeding. I will post post-deploy notes and timeline in this thread.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled at 00:30 UTC. Canary step starting 00:32 UTC. Will post progress updates.

marie: (after deploy) Canary healthy at 5% after 10m. Metrics: error-rate 0.2%, p95 latency +30ms. Rolling to 25%.

sam: Observing slight KV miss bump but within safe bounds. Continuing.

deploy-bot: 25% -> healthy. Final ramp to 100% initiated.

marie: Final status: roll completed at 00:48 UTC. No rollback needed. Will file release note and incident-free hotfix summary. Thanks all for quick approvals :rocket:
